verdict.rationale: Apify supports exporting scraped datasets in portable formats (CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML) via API/client, which addresses data portability, and Actors are code-based so job logic isn't locked into a proprietary format. However, there is no evidence of a bulk export/migration tool for job configurations (schedules, tasks, webhooks, proxy settings) or documented guidance for migrating away from Apify to another provider — docs only cover migrating projects INTO Apify. missing for 10: dedicated migration-out documentation, bulk config export tooling, evidence of task/schedule/webhook config portability, independent confirmation of lock-in-free migration.
